messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — product asked for firm commitments on region expansion and GPU availability for Q4. We need to finalize which SKUs we order this quarter and what the launch readiness criteria are.

kai_infra: what are the hard constraints? lead times, budget, or SLAs?

maria_pm: all three. customer asks = EU private deployments + Dedicated capacity for 2 enterprise deals. finance needs a number for committed spend by EOD Friday.

raj_fin: rough budgets look ok but we need SKU-level estimates. can we get a small matrix: SKU / units / expected throughput / cost delta?

ben_eng: +1 on matrix. also need to call out perf targets: 99th p99 latency for small chat payloads and sustained throughput for batch inference.

kai_infra: initial proposal: mix of H100 customs for Dedicated (predictable perf) + a small pool of A800s as a spot/backfill layer. lead times: H100 procurement ~12-16 weeks; A800 ~4-6 weeks.

ben_eng: does that line up with the customer timelines?

maria_pm: customer wants EU beta in 10 weeks. so H100s won't arrive in time for initial beta. options: 1) use cloud partner for EU beta (short-term) and commit to H100s for GA; 2) accelerate H100 orders with premium lead time (cost hit); 3) scale existing NA capacity and provide cross-region routing (privacy concerns).

kai_infra: option 1 seems lowest risk for beta. we can reserve geo-isolated partner infra and treat it as a temporary Dedicated mirror. need security signoff though.

sophia_prod: product side prefers minimal tech debt — option 1 + explicit migration plan to Dedicated H100 for GA. must include rollout criteria: performance parity tests, encryption/KMS validation, and at least two customer pilot successes.

raj_fin: cost implications: partner infra for beta will be higher per-token. add a line item for migration runbook and extra egress costs. I'll model both scenarios and share numbers tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Deploy reminder: stg-load-test scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC (automated).

ben_eng: for launch criteria checklist draft:
- infra: capacity reserved for peak QPS + 25% buffer
- perf: p50/p95/p99 within agreed SLOs vs baseline
- ops: playbook for fallback to NA region
- security: KMS + audit logs validated
- cost: committed monthly burn validated with finance

maria_pm: love it. also add canary rollback time budget (max 15m) and monitoring alerts for model-regression.

kai_infra: operational notes — if we do H100 GA, we should stagger shipments across two data centers to reduce single-DC risk. implies small extra networking setup.

ben_eng: also we should define quantization/instance profiles for each SKU so model owners know expected perf/cost tradeoffs. I can draft that.

maria_pm: action items:
- ben_eng: draft SKU throughput + perf profile (due 48h)
- raj_fin: cost scenarios for partner-beta vs accelerated H100 (due 24h)
- kai_infra: security checklist for partner infra + DC stagger plan (due 48h)
- sophia_prod: finalize pilot success criteria + migration runbook (due 72h)

kai_infra: noted. I'll also include lead-time risk matrix and contingency triggers.

sophia_prod: can we include a customer communication template for the pilot? want legal to review too.

maria_pm: yes — include legal in thread when draft is ready. thanks everyone.

kai_infra: fyi i'll tag infra-ticket later: INFRA-4123 with the procurement ask so procurement can start RFQs.

raj_fin: I'll ping procurement ops once I have numbers.

maria_pm: OK. reconvene Friday 11:00 to lock the decision. if anything blocks earlier, call it out here. :thumbsup:

ben_eng: +1

oncall-bot: Meeting scheduled: Friday 11:00 UTC — "Q4 infra procurement decision"

kai_infra: added ETA notes to INFRA-4123: H100 12-16w, A800 4-6w, cloud-partner 2w.

maria_pm: perfect. end."
